title: Vocal fold oscillation mechanics and its influencing factors
summary: Es wird untersucht, wie und ob sich die Stimmlippenmechanik durch Flüstern, durch Flüssigkeit, durch Geschwindigkeitsänderungen oder durch Vibrato verändert.
conditions: Polyp of vocal cord and larynx

interventions.name: Measurements of vocal function including high-speed glottography before and after (0min, 10min, 30min) after intervention of various interventions (stressed whispering, fluid intake, tablets containing hyaluronic acid, LaxVox and for organic dysphonia with blue laser treatment)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
vocally healthy, for one study organic dysphionia
Exclusion criteria:
pregnancy, voice complaints
